title: Insert Excel Value (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Insert Excel Value applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Excel Value (BtnInsertExcelValue) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Excel value link tag codec is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The oPE_ExcelValue newline-delimited key=value AlternativeText codec round-trips all fields (path/sheet/cell/dec/thou/pct/raw/id/start/len/text) with invariant raw numbers (never a locale decimal comma), documented fallbacks for unparsable fields (decimals/start/length -1, raw null, booleans only on exact '1'), values keeping everything after the first '=', carriage-return tolerance, null reference fields for missing keys, and rejection of non-tag payloads.
